name: MonarchCookieConsentBanner
title: CookieConsentBanner
summary: The first-run consent card of an app that uses cookies or similar tracking: a title, the explanation with a link to the policy, and the choices of the regime (opt-in, opt-out or notice).
whenToUse: On first run of an app, or of web content inside it, that sets optional cookies or tracking and must ask or inform before it does.
whenNotToUse: For the detailed per-category choices, use consent-preferences behind "Customize". For the system tracking prompt on iOS, use the platform API.
api: @Composable fun MonarchCookieConsentBanner(regime: MonarchCookieConsentRegime, onDecide: (MonarchCookieConsentChoice) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, onCustomize: (() -> Unit)? = null, onPolicyClick: (() -> Unit)? = null, announce: Boolean = false, labels: MonarchCookieConsentBannerLabels = MonarchCookieConsentBannerLabels())
enum class MonarchCookieConsentRegime { OptIn, OptOut, Notice }
enum class MonarchCookieConsentChoice { AcceptAll, RejectAll, Acknowledge, DoNotSell }

class MonarchCookieConsentBannerLabels(title: String? = null, description: String? = null, acceptAll: String? = null, rejectAll: String? = null, customize: String? = null, acknowledge: String? = null, doNotSell: String? = null, policy: String? = null)

options.name: regime
options.description: OptIn (Customize, Reject all, Accept all), OptOut (Do not sell or share my personal information, OK) or Notice (OK); it also picks the explanation.

options.name: onDecide
options.description: Called with the choice; the app stores it and stops showing the card.

options.name: onCustomize
options.description: Opens the app's detailed preferences; null hides "Customize". Opt-in only.

options.name: onPolicyClick
options.description: Opens the cookie policy; null shows no "Cookie policy" link.

options.name: announce
options.description: Whether TalkBack reads the card when it appears (a polite live region).

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the title, the explanation and each button and link.

states.name: opt-in
states.description: "Customize" as a ghost button, then "Reject all" and "Accept all" with the same look.

states.name: opt-out
states.description: "Do not sell or share my personal information" and "OK".

appearance: A raised card: the raised surface with a subtle border and the large shadow, the title in the default text, the explanation muted and the policy link in the link colour, underlined. Reject and accept are both secondary buttons. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web banner is fixed to the bottom of the viewport (or a corner card), reads and stores the decision through ConsentProvider, and honours the browser's Global Privacy Control signal. On Android the card is placed by the app (a Scaffold's bottomBar or above the content), and the app stores the decision from onDecide; there is no Global Privacy Control signal in an app. Positions bottom-start, bottom-end and bottom-center are not offered.
accessibility: The card is a pane named by its title, and a traversal group read before its buttons.
The title is a heading; the policy link is a link inside the explanation.
Every button has a touch target of at least 48dp; reject and accept look the same, so neither is suggested by colour.
With announce, the card is a polite live region.
edgeCases: Long translations wrap the buttons onto more lines.
Without onPolicyClick the explanation ends without a link.

examples.title: Opt-in (ask first)
examples.code:
MonarchCookieConsentBanner(
    regime = MonarchCookieConsentRegime.OptIn,
    onDecide = { decision = it },
    onCustomize = { preferencesOpen = true },
    onPolicyClick = { policyOpen = true },
)

examples.title: Opt-out (sale or sharing)
examples.code:
MonarchCookieConsentBanner(
    regime = MonarchCookieConsentRegime.OptOut,
    onDecide = { decision = it },
    labels = MonarchCookieConsentBannerLabels(title = "Your privacy choices"),
)

examples.title: Notice
examples.code:
MonarchCookieConsentBanner(
    regime = MonarchCookieConsentRegime.Notice,
    onDecide = { decision = it },
    labels = MonarchCookieConsentBannerLabels(title = "About cookies"),
)
